choices.reason: No rule separates the candidates: the available paper's abstract and RQ1 jointly present flexibility, fluency, and originality without naming a primary outcome or comparator; the separate online appendix was unavailable. Rule 3 concerns alternative analyses of the same outcome and contrast, so it cannot rank these different outcomes or controls, and the remaining rules do not distinguish their common AI arm, session, and full arm coverage.

choices.quote: The results showed that the human–ChatGPT group generated the most flexible and fluent solutions, while the human–human group produced the most original solutions in solving mathematical creativity tasks.
